resources.string: BashLock Device Administration protects retail installment compliance, blocks uninstallation by unauthorized users, and executes remote locking.
Uninstalling or disabling BashLock Device Administration is strictly prohibited under your mobile installment contract.
BashLock Security Service protects device admin settings and prevents unauthorized deactivation or uninstallation without the Shopkeeper Master PIN.
Enter 6-digit Master PIN to access Device Admin settings
